verdict.rationale: Paddle publishes official SDKs (Node.js, others referenced), a maintained OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Postman collection for generating clients, plus AI-native extensions (MCP servers, agent skills, LLM benchmark) explicitly designed for building against Paddle programmatically, corroborated by independent probes confirming live endpoints. missing for 10: no independent third-party review of SDK quality/coverage beyond Paddle's own docs, and community evidence is limited to support/pricing complaints rather than SDK-specific feedback.
